args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Fixed in
2.9.4; upgrading within the same major version as a minimal change.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

## Details
- Per the advisory, all versions <2.9.4 are affected; fixed in 2.9.4. Chose 2.9.4 as the minimal patch upgrade within the same major version to reduce risk of breaking changes (3.x would be a major-version jump).
- No code changes required.

## CI
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: passed.
